claim: The demo never reads or writes live stockroom, operator, session, profile, reminder, or license state.
sandbox: browser preloads hostile live state, starts a delayed live license check on /, enters /?demo=1 in one click, releases the response, uses and resets the demo, and asserts every real key is byte-for-byte unchanged

claim: The landing action opens a sample stockroom with three sample SKUs and one active hold; Reset demo restores that sample.
where: landing hero, sample preview, README, demo guide
sandbox: fresh browser opens the landing page, enters /?demo=1 in one click, asserts the seed, creates a second hold, resets, and asserts the original three SKUs and one hold with no persisted demo keys

claim: Stock Promise has no advertising or behavioral analytics.
sandbox: fresh context visits home, privacy, and demo, creates a demo hold, and asserts every request is same-origin and no cookie is set

claim: Live operator profiles, licenses, and reminder settings use browser local storage.
sandbox: fresh local live workspace signs in, creates a hold, restores a fixture license, saves an operator profile, enables reminders, and asserts each value is in its documented browser storage

claim: Sociobot sign-in tokens stay in the current browser session.
sandbox: hosted-auth browser server uses the production Sociobot tenant and client configuration; a fixture identity exchange completes /auth/callback through MSAL, then the test asserts the hydrated MSAL token cache is in sessionStorage and absent from localStorage

claim: Hosted access uses Sociobot Microsoft Entra External ID.
where: live access screen, privacy page, README
sandbox: default production auth configuration asserts CIAM mode, the Sociobot customer tenant, and the registered application client

claim: People without a valid location role cannot read its inventory, holds, outcomes, or audit record.
sandbox: CIAM-mode SQLite app contains an inventory item, active hold, outcome, and audit row; unauthenticated, wrong-tenant, and role-less signed requests each receive 401 from bootstrap and audit before records are returned

claim: The first supervisor creates the location, and later setup attempts cannot replace it.
sandbox: fresh in-memory app starts without a location, accepts the first supervisor setup, returns a supervisor session, and rejects a second setup

claim: Inventory, holds, outcomes, and the audit record persist in the hosted database so coworkers see the same stock.
sandbox: fresh file-backed app creates inventory and a hold in one supervisor session, observes both from a second session, reopens the database, and confirms the location, stock, hold, and audit record remain

claim: Supervisors can export hold outcomes as CSV.
sandbox: fresh demo browser context downloads CSV and asserts its header and a sample outcome

claim: The sample demo opens offline after its first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context visits /demo, waits for service worker control, goes offline, and reloads

claim: Staff create holds; supervisors change stock and resolve holds.
sandbox: in-memory local auth state gives a staff session and asserts create hold is allowed while inventory and resolution are denied

claim: The API slows excessive requests with a retry time.
sandbox: fresh in-memory app sends more than the public status allowance from one forwarded client IP and asserts 429 plus Retry-After

claim: Supervisors can remove resolved hold details after a chosen retention period.
where: data retention settings, privacy page, README
sandbox: in-memory SQLite marks an old resolved hold and asserts its customer, note, and operator fields are redacted while the audit row remains

claim: Timed holds expire automatically.
where: landing page, active-hold form, outcomes, README
sandbox: in-memory SQLite contains a past-due active hold; bootstrap runs expiry and asserts stock is available, the outcome is expired, and an audit event exists

claim: Stock Promise prevents a second hold from taking unavailable stock.
sandbox: two concurrent authenticated hold attempts request two units from three available units; exactly one is created and one conflicts

claim: Supervisors can review an append-only audit record.
sandbox: in-memory SQLite converts a hold, verifies the recorded audit event, and proves an audit-row delete fails

claim: A supervisor can permanently erase the whole location.
sandbox: an in-memory location with stock, a hold, session, and audit event is erased after an explicit DELETE confirmation; all location tables are empty and the audit trigger is restored

claim: A verified Pro license enables saved operator profiles and optional on-device expiry reminders.
sandbox: fresh demo browser has a cached verified test license and a near-expiry sample hold; it saves a profile, enables notifications, observes an on-device notification, and reuses the profile in the hold form

claim: Existing license holders can restore a license in settings.
sandbox: fresh demo browser pastes a fixture license; an intercepted billing verification returns valid, the license is stored locally, and Pro controls appear without leaving the product

claim: Paid upgrades are temporarily unavailable.
sandbox: fresh local landing, demo settings, and terms pages show the unavailable status and expose no checkout link, preventing the independently recorded checkout 404 from reaching customers

claim: Core holds and CSV export do not require a license.
sandbox: fresh demo browser without a license creates a hold and exports its outcomes CSV while Pro controls remain locked
